items.item_text: 01. What experience do you have working with CDCR facilities?

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Coordinates incarcerated student support services and ensures compliance with all educational program provisions in the District's contract with CDCR. 2. Proactively responds to requests for information from incarcerated students. Implements corrective action plans when needed and ensures all required corrective actions are completed. 3. Travels to off-site locations and represents the District as incarcerated student programs liaison; Coordinates District on site visits to CDCR facilities. 4. Develops, recommends, and implements program plans and objectives; collaborates with stakeholders to enhance program goals and efficiency; coordinates delivery of services to program participants; makes sure program requirements are followed. 5. Operates a computer and other office equipment as assigned; provides clerical support including note taking, typing, filling, scanning, and digitally archiving documents and uploading meeting agenda minutes and other documents to Boardocs or appropriate systems. 6. Collaborates with required stakeholders to develop, maintain, and distribute the PVC guidesand documents. 7. Develops and coordinates the delivery of Rising Scholar related workshops, seminars, and meetings. 8. Plans, develops, and implements programs and initiatives to advance student retention; participates in developing and evaluating plans and work processes to achieve annual component goals, objectives, and standards; Provides guidance to ensure seamless delivery of educational and support services to incarcerated students by all departments. 9. Maintains the District's Rising Scholars website with readily accessible resources for incarcerated students' families and/or representatives. 10. Coordinates and manages meetings, travel, and events to support and enhance incarcerated student support services and provide program updates. 11. Meets with assigned students to connect them with on campus support services and resources and ensure they are receiving the maximum aid available. 12. Serves as liaison and information resource to faculty, staff, students, CDCR personnel and other stakeholders regarding incarcerated students enrollment programs, policies, procedures, and practices. 13. Designs and produces print and electronic media to promote resources and services for students; prepares and distributes professional communications to faculty, staff, students, CDCR personnel, and other stakeholders. 14. Maintains knowledge of all District, Federal and State guidelines, policies, regulations, and procedures applicable to assigned programs; makes recommendations to constituent groups to assure program compliance. 15. Creates and maintains a variety of confidential records and files for incarcerated students; processes student forms and correspondence; prepares data and reports required by the District, CDCR, and other agencies; participates in departmental program review. 16. Collaborates with teaching teams in planning practice placements and assignments for incarcerated students. 17. Responsible for ensuring that affiliation agreements for each institution are current. Maintains accurate database of CDCR institutions and personnel for contact and placement. 18. Reviews budgets and projections with assigned administrator; inputs requisitions and prepares reports as needed that evaluate and demonstrate program effectiveness; ensures program expenditures are within allocated budgets. 19. Required to drive to off-campus sites. 20. Participates in District, State, and Region sponsored professional development programs. 21. Maintains a friendly, supportive, collaborative atmosphere for student, staff, faculty, CDCR personnel, and the public. 22. Performs other related duties as assigned.
